title: Sample series bible
audience: curious beginners who want a path, not one video per source file
throughline: Episode count follows a learning path. Humans approve the bible before scripts are generated.
notes_for_human: Template only. Copy to pipeline/series/<id>/bible.json, edit, then run learntok series-bible --bible <path> --approve.

episodes.title: What is this idea?
episodes.one_liner: Name the thing before you explain the machinery.
episodes.hook: Why should anyone care before the jargon starts?

episodes.title: How does it actually work?
episodes.one_liner: Walk the moving parts without dumping the whole textbook.
episodes.hook: If the idea is so simple, why does the mechanism look messy?
episodes.recap_from_prev: We named the idea and the everyday analogy.

episodes.title: Where does the idea break?
episodes.one_liner: Every model has assumptions; show the ones that actually bite.
episodes.hook: What happens when the tidy story meets a messy world?
episodes.recap_from_prev: We walked the mechanism with one worked example.

episodes.title: How do you practice it?
episodes.one_liner: Turn the path into a check you can reuse on the next topic.
episodes.hook: If you only remember one checklist, what is on it?
episodes.recap_from_prev: We saw where the assumptions break.
